meta.name: auditing-uefi-firmware-with-chipsec
meta.description: Use Intel CHIPSEC to assess platform firmware configuration, SPI flash write protection, BIOS lock, SMM/SMRR, and Secure Boot variable state, dump SPI flash, and triage UEFI variables for firmware-level threats.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要检查UEFI固件是否存在安全漏洞或配置不当
copy.tagline_en: Audit UEFI firmware security with CHIPSEC
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check UEFI firmware for security vulnerabilities or misconfigurations

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能指导你使用 CHIPSEC 工具检查电脑固件安全，包括 SPI 闪存写保护、BIOS 锁、SMM/SMRR 和 Secure Boot 变量状态，还能导出 SPI 闪存内容并分析 UEFI 变量。
howto.when: 当你需要评估一台 x86 电脑的固件安全配置，或怀疑存在固件级威胁（如 bootkit）时触发。需要 root/管理员权限。

say.text: 帮我用 CHIPSEC 检查这台电脑的 BIOS 写保护是否开启。
导出 SPI 闪存内容并解码，用于离线分析。
say.note: 执行 spi dump 和 decode 命令。

say.text: 列出所有 UEFI 变量，检查是否有异常条目。
say.note: 运行 uefi var-list 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you to use CHIPSEC to check platform firmware security: SPI flash write protection, BIOS lock, SMM/SMRR, Secure Boot variable state, dump SPI flash, and triage UEFI variables.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to assess firmware security of an x86 platform or suspect firmware-level threats (e.g., bootkits). Requires root/admin access.

say_en.text: Use CHIPSEC to check if BIOS write protection is enabled on this machine.
Dump the SPI flash and decode it for offline analysis.
say_en.note: Executes spi dump and decode commands.

say_en.text: List all UEFI variables and check for anomalies.
